title: Dhaka Bypass Expressway Facilitates Unhindered Eid Travels
excerpt: The newly opened section of the Dhaka Bypass Expressway has significantly improved travel experience during Eid, providing unhindered movement for thousands of travelers.

title: Dhaka Bypass Expressway to Open Partly on 1 May
excerpt: The 48-kilometre Dhaka bypass expressway is set to open partly on 1 May to facilitate smoother operation for buses, trucks, and other vehicles from northern and western regions to southern and eastern regions.

title: 18km Dhaka Bypass Expressway Opened to Traffic Ahead of Eid
excerpt: A significant portion of the Dhaka Bypass Expressway has been opened to traffic ahead of Eid celebrations, marking a major milestone in the project's development.

title: Dhaka Bypass Expressway to be Operational by July
excerpt: The entire Dhaka Bypass Expressway project is scheduled to be fully operational by July, promising to revolutionize transportation around the capital.

title: Government of Bangladesh Signs PPP Contract for Dhaka Bypass
excerpt: The Government of Bangladesh has signed a landmark public-private partnership contract for the development of the Dhaka Bypass Expressway project.

title: Dhaka Bypass Project Details
excerpt: Comprehensive information about the Dhaka Bypass project, including technical specifications, financial arrangements, and implementation timeline.
